description: Check the status of a video generation started by make_ugc or make_faceless, or of a generate_image or generate_video run. Pass the run_id, and wait_seconds to hold the answer until the run ends. While the run is still working it returns status IN_PROGRESS with poll.arguments: call again with them until it reaches a terminal state — SUCCEEDED (with video_url, or generation.url for generate_image and generate_video) or FAILED, with display_markdown to show.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds (at most 50) for the run to end before answering.

name: get_run
title: Get run status
